description: This file defines a React functional component 'Dock' that implements a MacOS-style bottom dock. It displays application icons, handles app launching, and indicates open apps with a dot. It leverages other icon components and manages app state via props.

methods.name: Dock({ openApp, windows, windowOrder })
methods.description: React functional component rendering the MacOS style dock with app icons, indicating open and frontmost apps, and handling app launch.

methods.name: isAppOpen(appId)
methods.description: Checks if a specified app is currently open and not minimized or closed.

methods.name: isAppFrontmost(appId)
methods.description: Determines whether the specified app is the frontmost app based on window order.
